summary: Comprehensive testing of Recipe Image Upload feature for German Meal Planner. All backend API endpoints (upload, serve, delete) work correctly. Frontend UI components (gallery, thumbnails, upload zones) are fully functional. Real Object Storage integration is working - no mocked APIs.
passed_tests: POST /api/recipes/{id}/images uploads an image file and returns updated images array
GET /api/images/{path} serves the uploaded image with correct content-type
DELETE /api/recipes/{id}/images removes an image from the recipe's images array
After upload, recipe.image_url is automatically set if it was null
After deleting the current image_url, it falls back to next image or null
GET /api/recipes/{id} returns images array (backward compat: old recipes get empty array)
Uploading invalid file types is rejected with error (400)
GET /api/recipes returns recipes with image_url that can be resolved
RecipeDetail page shows image gallery with navigation arrows when multiple images exist
RecipeDetail page shows thumbnail strip under gallery for image selection
RecipeDetail page has upload button (+ icon) in thumbnail strip for adding more images
RecipeDetail page has delete button on gallery image (visible on hover)
RecipeDetail page shows upload placeholder when recipe has no images (owner only)
RecipeForm shows existing images as thumbnails with delete buttons
RecipeForm has drag & drop zone for new images
RecipeForm has URL input as fallback
RecipesPage cards show uploaded images correctly (resolving /api/images paths)

seed_data.recipe_with_image: recipe_ac29cd0b382a (Spaghetti Carbonara) - has 1 uploaded test image

context_for_next_testing_agent: Image upload feature is fully implemented and tested. Backend uses Emergent Object Storage (init_storage, put_object, get_object). Images stored at paths like kochplaner/recipes/{recipe_id}/{image_id}.{ext} and served via GET /api/images/{path}. Frontend resolves /api/images/... paths by prepending API base URL. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF (max 10 MB). RecipeDetail shows gallery with navigation, thumbnails, upload button, delete button. RecipeForm has drag & drop zone, URL fallback, existing image thumbnails with delete.

backend_endpoints.GET /api/images/{path}: Serve image from object storage with correct Content-Type

RecipeDetail.gallery: Shows current image with navigation arrows (if multiple)
RecipeDetail.thumbnails: Strip below gallery for image selection
RecipeDetail.upload_button: In thumbnail strip for adding more images
RecipeDetail.delete_button: On gallery image, visible on hover

RecipeForm.drop_zone: Drag & drop area for new images
RecipeForm.pending_files: Preview of files to be uploaded on save
